project_type: Electron desktop app with React, Three.js, Web Audio API
build_system: Vite for bundling, electron-builder for packaging
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install, 2. Run pnpm build to confirm TypeScript compiles and Vite bundles, 3. Run pnpm test to confirm tests pass, 4. Run pnpm typecheck for type verification
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to npm registries. Node v22 available. No display server for Electron GUI testing, but build and type-check are feasible. Cannot run Electron in headless mode for integration tests.
key_patterns: Modular architecture with separate engine systems (audio, render, shader, scene, camera, particle, preset). Each system is a self-contained module with clean interfaces. React components use functional style with hooks. Three.js scenes are managed via a render engine abstraction. GLSL shaders stored as separate .glsl files.
directory_structure: src/main (Electron main process), src/renderer (React app), src/core (engine core), src/audio-engine (audio analysis), src/render-engine (Three.js pipeline), src/shaders (GLSL), src/scenes (visualizer modes), src/effects (post-processing), src/particles (GPU particles), src/camera (camera system), src/presets (preset management), src/plugins (plugin architecture), src/community (community features), src/ui (React components), src/utils (utilities), src/config (configuration), src/assets (static assets)
